title: Exposure policies in sequential discovery
purpose: Test whether POPULARITY or EXPOSURE_BALANCED slates change mean agent welfare versus RANDOM
primary_outcome: Mean agent welfare W (paired difference vs RANDOM, equal-weight mean over 9 cells)
planned_analysis: Stratified bootstrap CI and stratified sign-flip test, Holm over 2 contrasts

title: Centralized two-sided matching versus sequential discovery
purpose: Compare DA_A, DA_B and MAXW with RANDOM sequential discovery on the same markets; blocking pairs of MAXW vs DA_A
primary_outcome: Mean agent welfare W (DA_A vs RANDOM); blocking pairs per 100 agents (MAXW vs DA_A)
planned_analysis: Paired stratified bootstrap CIs, secondary (no multiplicity protection)

title: Sensitivity of the exposure-policy effect
purpose: Check whether the EXP-001 effect sign survives pickiness, horizon and welfare-definition changes
primary_outcome: theta_P under S1 (theta 0.3/0.7), S2 (T 10/40), S3 (metric reanalysis)
planned_analysis: Pre-specified invalidation criterion: opposite sign with 95% CI excluding 0
